english.title: Fail to stop and report vehicle accident - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Liverpool John Lennon Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY PART OF AIRPORT..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) involved in an accident by which personal injury was caused to someone other than yourself or damage was caused to a vehicle other than the vehicle which you were driving or was caused to an animal other than one in the vehicle you were driving or was caused to property constructed on, fixed in, growing in or otherwise forming part of the land on which the road in question was situated or land adjacent to such land, failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the owner of the vehicle, the registration number or identification marks of the vehicle and details of the accident to a constable, airport official or other person having reasonable grounds for requiring them as soon as reasonably practicable and in any event no later than 24 hours after the accident
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 8(2) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
